entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for User, Session, and Agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval and is available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It provides automated fact extraction, context fencing, and connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. It employs a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading architecture to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without requiring LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and is accessible via Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control (commit, branch, and merge). It features an interactive TUI and REPL interface with sub-100ms retrieval across five tiers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that combines vector search and structured facts with an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure of Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store to build depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG. It provides agent tools specifically for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets to provide portable state across Hermes Agent and other clients like Claude Code. It features local custody of SQLite and workspace files, achieving a 97.6% average accuracy on LongMemEval.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It is designed for multi-agent systems and provides local-first, zero-cost search for Hermes and Cursor.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval through BM25 and vector search and integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, long-term memory solution uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family including an MCP server and a Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall. It includes built-in contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server that utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide an evidence packet per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It supports automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to ensure users maintain ownership of their data. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It includes a dashboard to track estimated savings in tool-schema tokens.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It renders context locally without hosted services and supports MCP via stdio or SSE.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server facilitates API payments using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to allow agents to pay for API usage.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon. It offers hybrid recall capabilities using HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides five native tools for managing and searching local artifacts. It features a proactive router skill and supports automatic tool-OKF generation through an opt-in process.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes hybrid search methods—combining BM25, vector, and graph techniques—and performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It runs on localhost and supports grounded Q&A featuring file-and-line citations.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes subagent-driven-development for task execution. It includes specific phases for brainstorming and design refinement to support its software development methodology.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first prototyping system that supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats. It is compatible with various coding agents and local CLI executables through its automation and plugin features.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions using a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers client support for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills spanning 29 security domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It features self-check and auto-fix capabilities to generate diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns. It supports Hermes and includes three operational modes along with optional voice profiles for prose styling.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement through an Agentic Evolver. It integrates with Hermes and provides a dashboard for inspecting session traces and skills.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library containing 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It includes a master router, connector skills, and vendored copies of official protocol skills.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1078 professional agent skills in plain markdown format. These skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with export options for other assistants.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation alongside management slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It enhances reasoning by reporting findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running agents using a three-level work model with file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository provides skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, error handling, and JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files from repositories or documentation URLs. It ensures provenance through file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features via TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It provides real-time tracking of progress and decisions alongside built-in rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This workflow language for AI uses a single file and four verbs to enable local-first execution with any LLM. It provides static auditing via nika check and generates hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and provides incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill uses a 5-layer retrieval system—including hard triggers, FTS5, and dense embeddings—to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces such as CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and preserves non-English prompts using langid or Unicode-range heuristics.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial bug-hunting and code review. It integrates a deterministic pre-scan layer with Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec, and uses an MCP server to generate suppression rules.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for task state management.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification and features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This.NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill employs a three-agent swarm to target code hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system and includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This tool generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This repository provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. The packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This project offers scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository provides an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.

entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It allows for kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state via mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository provides a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment. It features declarative configuration for workspace documents and hybrid skill management for Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and identities. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM-based analysts, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical roles, to perform financial trading. It incorporates risk and portfolio management and supports local Ollama models alongside various LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform manages multi-agent workflows and monitors spend across frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API for task tracking and scheduling.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI, web dashboard, and CLI to manage diverse coding agents such as Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegating tasks between orchestrators and specialists. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management using Hermes Agent profiles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling and is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This project provides a local MCP server that creates a pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports multiple programming languages and includes automatic synchronization for file changes.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool and visualization dashboard tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It supports data from clients such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This tool acts as a local trace viewer for inspecting API traffic from Hermes Agent and other clients like Gemini and Cursor. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, account limits, and session details with multi-device synchronization. It reads Hermes Agent state directly and offers historical usage trends and breakdowns.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating applications with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows and supports autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configuration.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents through encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce via Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without OAuth or separate processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and vLLM/GGUF inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It supports providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama and features a supervisor sidebar, action undo, and session snapshots.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, and the Claude Agent SDK. It includes editor tooling for VS Code, Slack, and Telegram, as well as a plugin for Claude Code to capture tool traces and prompts.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through token-saving CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance and offers automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configurations, skills, and memories. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents through project-local instructions and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services to facilitate rapid deployment. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It supports JSON, YAML, Markdown, and Python files and utilizes HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps OpenClaw configs and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing modes to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependency. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides fully local voice interaction with support for 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro. It features adaptive turn-taking, echo suppression, and three trigger modes: wake word, console, and PTT.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides an all-in-one interface to manage multiple agentic tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: An open-source cowork app that aggregates multiple external agents like OpenClaw and Hermes Agent into a single interface. It features built-in professional assistants for document creation and supports remote access via messaging apps and WebUI.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface that provides full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. The layout features three panels, including a chat window and a workspace file browser.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing and configuring Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard that supports desktop, npm CLI, and Docker distributions. It offers visual workflow building, Kanban task tracking, and manages 10 platform channels including Telegram and Discord.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog. It includes a PTY terminal, Monaco editor, and a file browser to support Swarm Mode with tmux-backed workers.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and Codex. It supports delegation to sub-agents and offers native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides embedded terminal access for system repair alongside views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, Rust, React, and TypeScript. It supports Windows and macOS and includes an integrated Hermes-CN-Core runtime.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser contexts to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent gateways. It includes Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting and Hermes Web Alpha for session management.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents. It supports real-time streaming chat, file attachments, and management of agent tasks and skills.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop workspace featuring one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, alongside a live workspace for monitoring diffs and code writes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and agent status panel. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that provides searchable history for ten different agent sources. This local-only tool tracks per-session quotas for 5-hour and weekly limits without remote logging.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that bridges local agents to a web interface via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for managing requests with side effects.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted AI assistance. It provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It offers real-time tracking of session activity and costs, alongside read-only inspection of conversation histories and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
